Name: VWW - OURple kitchen
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
Changes the farmhouse kitchen, island kitchen and mini fridge into something OURple!

I thought to myself "Why not make a whole OURple series?" so I made this kitchen. I might make more, who knows? I sure don't but what I do know is that I always lose to scope creep, haha! 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Generally Compatible. Not compatible with other kitchen retextures for obvious reasons.
